cards.title: Train AI Models
cards.description: Complete short quality-control tasks that help improve model performance and earn pay per task where available.
bullets: Task examples: data labeling, text annotation, and model evaluation.
Typical tasks take 1–15 minutes; speed and accuracy affect qualification.
Task availability and eligibility change by project—follow external platform rules for each posting.

cards.title: Earn Money Online
cards.description: Pick paid microtasks—like prompt testing and text annotation—and get paid per completed task when eligible.
bullets: Examples include prompt testing, data labeling, tagging, and simple transcription.
Pay varies by task; review pay rates and acceptance criteria before starting (no income guarantee).
Check task availability, your eligibility, and external platform rules on every assignment.

cards.title: Remote, Flexible Work
cards.description: Do remote tasks on your schedule—accept work when available and build a reputation for quality.
bullets: Common task types: model evaluation, prompt testing, and data labeling.
Eligibility requirements and task availability differ by project; keep your profile and qualifications current.
Always follow external platform rules and task-specific instructions to remain eligible.
